targetSet.definition: Exactly the degree+placement+arm cells classified MIXED in the frozen Component-Placement Junction Law v1 train result.
targetSet.derivation: Read diagnostics from the exact train catalogue bound by catalogueSha256 6e1d0b4a9d093e38423108a3711cc3bd32ee2a68668b078fd332401f24bf7543; select classification == MIXED; sort deterministically; hash and freeze the target list before parent-state compilation.

parentStateInstrument.stateBasis: frozen local relational-state clustering at primary minimum context mass 64
parentStateInstrument.missingParentState: retained diagnostically as UNPARENTED_STATE but excluded from primary parent-state cells

independentDirectionalBasis.role: Motivates parent state as an evidence-backed directional coordinate; transition-grammar outcome statistics are not used to classify current law cells.

hypothesis.statement: Among placement-level cells that remain mixed, the frozen local state of the smallest containing parent is an omitted relational-state coordinate. Conditioning on parent state will separate at least some strict-match and strict-reverse source populations into direction-consistent sublaws.
hypothesis.strongResolution: An original MIXED placement cell is TWO_SIDED_RESOLVED only if its testable parent-state subcells contain at least one MATCH_ONLY and at least one REVERSE_ONLY subcell and contain no MIXED subcell.
hypothesis.oneSidedDeconfounding: An original MIXED placement cell is ONE_SIDED_DECONFOUNDED if it has at least one MATCH_ONLY or REVERSE_ONLY testable parent-state subcell and no MIXED subcell, but the opposite original direction lacks a qualifying sublaw. This is not counted as proof that parent state explains the direction split.
hypothesis.falsification: If the same degree + exact placement + parentState + arm cell supports both STRICT_MATCH and STRICT_REVERSE across independent sources, parent state is insufficient for that state collision.

measurement.targetRestriction: Only contexts whose degree+placement+arm parent cell belongs to the frozen 67-cell train MIXED target set enter primary analysis.
measurement.endpointCenters: retained in compiler output but excluded from primary junction analysis
measurement.nullContract: unchanged source-local null: arm tokens are permuted only among centers with identical center kind and degree inside each observation. Placement and parent state are observation-level and remain fixed across observed and all 64 null worlds.
measurement.strictMatch: observed matching accuracy > every one of 64 source-local null matching accuracies
measurement.strictReverse: observed matching accuracy < every one of 64 source-local null matching accuracies

sequentialCustody.step1: Derive and hash the exact 67-cell target set from the frozen placement train artifact before reading any parent-state join outcome.
sequentialCustody.step2: Join train observations only to frozen parent states; discover/freeze parent-state sublaws and target-cell resolution classifications.
sequentialCustody.step3: Apply the frozen parent-state catalogue and frozen target-cell definitions to holdout with no refit.
sequentialCustody.step4: Apply holdout survivors to control with no refit.
sequentialCustody.joinBlindness: The component-placement law states and parent-state assignments were frozen independently. No parent-state assignment has previously been joined to placement-law strict direction.
sequentialCustody.provenance: No institution, object type, culture, language, chronology, occupant token, family id, target local-state id, or target topology is permitted.

classification: MATCH_ONLY if >=5 STRICT_MATCH sources and 0 STRICT_REVERSE
REVERSE_ONLY if >=5 STRICT_REVERSE sources and 0 STRICT_MATCH
trainDiscovery.candidateLaws: Only MATCH_ONLY or REVERSE_ONLY parent-state subcells enter the frozen validation catalogue.
targetCellResolution: TWO_SIDED_RESOLVED: >=1 MATCH_ONLY subcell, >=1 REVERSE_ONLY subcell, and 0 MIXED testable subcells.
ONE_SIDED_DECONFOUNDED: >=1 directional candidate, 0 MIXED testable subcells, but not both directions represented.
INSUFFICIENT_PARENT_STATE_SUPPORT: no parent-state subcell reaches >=10 eligible sources.

validation.passRule: Among decided sources (STRICT_MATCH + STRICT_REVERSE), >=90% reproduce the train-frozen direction and at least 5 reproduce it.
validation.twoSidedResolutionTransfer: A train TWO_SIDED_RESOLVED target is confirmed only if both frozen directional sublaws independently pass the lane gate.

verdict.SUPPORTED: At least one original placement-MIXED target is TWO_SIDED_RESOLVED on train and both directional sublaws transfer through holdout and control, with no tested parent-state subcell for that target becoming MIXED.
verdict.PARTIAL: Parent-state sublaws transfer, or one-sided deconfounding is reproducible, but no two-sided target survives both holdout and control or some tested parent-state subcells remain MIXED.
verdict.REJECTED: No parent-state sublaw survives both independent lanes and parent-state conditioning does not reproducibly reduce the target collisions.
